title: EgoEngine · 视觉与动作生成分支消融

description.zh: 官网把不同训练生成分支的作用以真机任务成功率消融图呈现，适合作为“机制贡献—实际指标”的布局参考。
description.en: An author-labeled ablation of visual and action generation branches, tied to real-robot policy evaluation rather than a decorative comparison.

zh: 机器人和多模块系统需要证明究竟哪个子模块产生实际收益时。
en: Presenting which module contributes to a robotics system's measured outcomes.

zh: 相同任务和指标下并列不同组件组合；与结果主图放在同一评价章节，便于追踪完整系统收益。
en: Align component variants under consistent task and success-rate metrics, adjacent to a separate main-outcome chart.

zh: 原作者结果不等于 OpenResearchAssets 独立复现；图中定量差异应以作者论文和实验设置为准。
en: Author-reported ablations are not independent replication; check the source paper and matched evaluation settings.
